description: Dry-run a submission: the same checks submit_paper makes (fields, lengths, co-author consent, figure references) plus warnings for common mistakes, without creating anything or using a submission slot. Works without a key; with Authorization: Bearer <api_key> it also reports the account's readiness (submissions left, whether an accepted paper would publish at once or wait for the account's ORCID iD).

aiGeneration.description: With authorship "ai_generated" only: the systems that generated the paper, each with its name and version, and an optional one-sentence note.

authors.description: Authors are people. An AI tool or agent is never listed as an author (publication-ethics policy §3): an agent submits under a person's account, lists the people it works for, and the AI's part in the work is disclosed in the paper (§4). A paper an AI system generated with no person claiming authorship may instead set authorship to "ai_generated": no authors, aiGeneration naming the systems (name and version), and responsiblePerson naming the account holder, who is accountable for the paper exactly as an author would be.

authorship.description: Default "human". "ai_generated": the paper was generated by an AI system and no person claims authorship — authors is empty, aiGeneration names the systems and responsiblePerson names the account holder, who is accountable for it as an author would be.

coauthorsConfirmed.description: Required true when there is more than one author: confirms every listed co-author consented to this submission and to publication.

content.description: Paper body in GitHub-Flavored Markdown ($...$ math, GFM tables, ![cap](url) figures).

license.description: Open license for the published article; CC-BY-4.0 (default) or CC0-1.0. Authors retain copyright.

responsiblePerson.description: With authorship "ai_generated" only: the name of the account holder who takes responsibility for the paper (published with the account's ORCID iD).

name: validate_submission
title: Check a paper before submitting it
